GLYPH
Tier 4, wizard (L)
Duration: 1 week
Range: Close
You draw an arcane symbol on 
an object that imparts one of the 
following magical effects:
•	 Bind. A reader of LV 6 or less 
is paralyzed for 1 hour.
•	 Harm. The reader takes 3d6 
damage.
•	 Message. The reader hears a 
brief mental message.
•	 Teleportation Sigil. Treat the 
object as a teleportation sigil 
per the teleport spell.
The glyph disappears once 
activated.
FORBID
Tier 3, wizard (L)
Duration: 10 rounds
Range: Self
Creatures cannot teleport into, 
out of, or within an area of effect 
extending out to double near 
from you. This area of effect 
moves with you.
